"Partial unreachability" better describes a state where *some* replicas are unreachable/unavailable. Yes: 4 of 5 pods are unschedulable/unreachable → the service is partially unreachable (its capacity/endpoints are partially missing). Endpoints list shows only 1 of the 5 intended → 80% of the intended endpoints are unreachable. That's "partial".

Alternatively the injector's approach for cordon: cordon the node(s) hosting the app's pods, then delete the app's pods → they can't reschedule. If they cordoned ALL nodes, the running pod on worker-02 wouldn't exist. Well, one pod exists (maybe it was uncordoned then...). Eh, synthetic data.
